question: What purifying effect does the deity’s leavings have even on an impure person?
premises: A person may be impure in self.
The deity’s leavings are described as purifying.
The verse states that such a person becomes pure.
inference: Even an impure person becomes pure through the purifying power of what the deity has eaten.
uncertainties: The phrase lobhāt creates tension with earlier condemnation of greed; the verse may be concessive or contrastive.
plain_english: An impure person becomes pure, for what has been eaten by me is purifying.
